products_meta_description: Discover our naturally grown farm produce, including butternut squash, kabocha squash, and seasonal vegetables.
products_butternut_description: Naturally sweet with a smooth, creamy texture and a slightly nutty flavour. Perfect for hearty soups, oven roasting, and homemade baking.
products_kabocha_description: A Japanese winter squash with rich orange flesh, a naturally sweet flavour, and a soft, fluffy texture. Delicious roasted, steamed, or added to soups.
products_green_beans_description: Fresh, crisp green beans with a mild, slightly sweet flavour. Enjoy them steamed, sautéed, or added to your favourite dishes.
products_hero_description: Good food starts with good growing practices. Explore our selection of fresh, naturally grown vegetables, straight from our farm to your table.
products_available_description: Discover our carefully grown selection of fresh produce.
products_upcoming_description: Here's a little preview of what's coming to our farm next season.
products_footer_description: Our produce is grown without synthetic pesticides, herbicides, or fertilizers, with a focus on natural growing practices and quality.
about_meta_description: Learn about our small-scale farm and our commitment to growing naturally without pesticides or fertilizers.
about_principle_healthier_description: We believe that health is the most important aspect of a person's life and the first step towards a healthy life is a healthy diet. Pesticides often leave residue on crops which can be extremely harmful for our health.
about_principle_tastier_description: We believe that natural is also tastier as well. Many of our customers emphasize that our organic crops taste much better than ones bought in typical supermarkets.
about_principle_eco_description: We believe in protecting the environment for ourselves and future generations. Chemical pesticies and fertilizers are actually very harmful for the enviornment.
about_step_pesticides_description:
Chemical Pesticides are absorbed by the roots and leaves of the plant and end up in the crop itself. 
 Chemical Pesticides also remain residually on the surface of the crops.
about_step_fertilizers_description:
Chemical Fertilizers are absorbed by the roots and leaves of the plant and end up in the crop itself. 
 We choose to use renewable and natural fertilizer instead, such as animal droppings.
about_step_harvest_description:
Instead of harvesting everything all at once by machine (usually harvesting early and unripe), 
 We choose to harvest weekly by hand, only picking those that are ripe.
about_hero_description: We are a small-scale farm dedicated to growing fresh, healthy produce naturally. No pesticides, no chemical fertilizers, just careful planting and a commitment to doing things naturally.
about_illustration_label: Illustration of plants growing in healthy soil under the sun
about_story_paragraph_1: We started with a simple idea: Healthier = Better. And that starts with a healthier diet. Everything today is so processed and we end up consuming so many harmful chemicals. That's why we choose to plant and eat more naturally, and in turn more healthy.
about_story_paragraph_2: Instead of focusing on growing as much as possible, we choose to grow on a smaller scale. This allows us to pay close attention to our plants, care for the soil, and follow the natural growing seasons.
about_story_paragraph_3: We take pride in growing healthier food. But this also results in growing on a smaller scale and having lower returns, due to having to manage pests manually and losing more crops due to pests.
about_footer_description: Small-scale farming, no pesticides, no fertilizers, and a commitment to caring for the land and everything we grow.
